IN ANNO SECUNDO DARII REGIS: In the second year of Darius the king
In anno secundo Darii regis: In the second year of Darius the king
in mense sexto in die una mensis factum: in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came
in manu Aggei prophete: by the hand of Aggeus the prophet
filium Salathiel ducem Iuda: the son of Salathiel, governor of Juda
et ad Iesum filium Iosedech sacerdotem m: and to Jesus the son of Josedec the high priest
Hec ait Dominus exercituum dicens: Popul: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, saying: This people saith: The time is not yet come for building the house of the Lord
Et factum est verbum Domini in manu Agge: And the word of the Lord came by the hand of Aggeus the prophet, saying
Numquid tempus vobis est ut habitetis in: Is it time for you to dwell in ceiled houses
Et nunc hec dicit Dominus exercituum:: And now thus saith the Lord of hosts
Seminastis multum et intulistis: You have sowed much, and brought in
you have drunk, but have not been filled with drink
you have clothed yourselves, but have not been warmed
Et qui mercedes congregavit misit eas in: and he that hath earned wages, put them into a bag with holes
Hec dicit Dominus exercituum: Ponite cor: Thus saith the Lord of hosts: Set Your hearts upon your ways
Quia domus mea deserta est et vos festin: because my house is desolate, and you make haste
et terra prohibita est ne daret germen s: and the earth was hindered from yielding her fruits
Et vocavi siccitatem: And I called for a drought
ET VOCAVI SICCITATEM: And I called for a drought
et super montes et super triticum et sup: and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the wine, and upon the oil, and upon all that the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon beasts, and upon all the labour of the hands
Et audivit Zorobabel filius Salathiel et: Then Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec the high priest, and all the remnant of the people hearkened
vocem Dei sui et verba Aggei prophete si: to the voice of the Lord their God, and to the words of Aggeus the prophet, as the Lord their God sent him to them: and the people feared before the Lord
ET DIXIT AGGEUS NUNTIUS DOMINI: And Aggeus the messenger of the Lord … spoke
spiritum Zorobabel filii Salathiel ducis: the spirit of Zorobabel the son of Salathiel governor of Juda, and the spirit of Jesus the son of Josedec the high priest, and the spirit of all the rest of the people: and they went in
in domo Domini exercituum Dei sui: in the house of the Lord of hosts their God
IN DIE VICESIMA: In the four and twentieth day
In septimo mense vicesima et prima mensi: And in the seventh month, the word of the Lord came
in manu Aggei prophete dicens:: by the hand of Aggeus the prophet, saying
Loquere ad Zorobabel filium Salathiel du: Speak to Zorobabel the son of Salathiel the governor of Juda, and to Jesus the son of Josedec the high priest, and to the rest of the people
Quis in vobis est derelictus qui vidit d: Who is left among you, that saw this house in its first glory? and how do you see it now?
et nunc confortare Zorobabel: Yet now take courage, O Zorobabel
dicit Dominus et confortare Iesu fili Io: saith the Lord, and take courage, O Jesus the son of Josedec the high priest, and take courage, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord of hosts: and perform
quod pepigi vobiscum est cum egredimini: that I covenanted with you when you came out
de terra Egypti et spiritus: of the land of Egypt: and … spirit
meus erit in medio vestrum: my … shall be in the midst of you
quia hec dicit Dominus exercituum: Adhuc: For thus saith the Lord of hosts: Yet one little while, and I will move the heaven and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land
et movebo omnes gentes: And I will move all nations
et veniet desideratus cunctis gentibus e: AND THE DESIRED OF ALL NATIONS SHALL COME: and I will fill this house with glory: saith the Lord of hosts
Meum est aurum et meum est argentum dici: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts
Magna erit gloria domus istius novissime: Great shall be the glory of this last house more than of the first, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place I will give peace
ET IN LOCO ISTO DABO: and in this place I will give
In vicesima et quarta die: In the four and twentieth day
noni mensis in anno secundo Darii: of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius
factum est verbum Domini ad Aggeum proph: the word of the Lord came to Aggeus the prophet, saying
Hec dicit Dominus Deus exercituum: Inter: Thus saith the Lord of hosts: Ask the priests the law, saying
Si tulerit homo carnem sanctificatam in: If a man carry sanctified flesh in the skirt of his garment, and touch with his skirt, bread, or pottage
aut vinum aut oleum aut omnem cibum, num: or wine, or oil, or any meat: shall it be sanctified? And the priests answered, and said: No
Et dixit Aggeus: Si tetigerit pollutus: And Aggeus said: If one that is unclean … touch
in anima ex omnibus his, numquid contami: by occasion of a soul … any of all these things, shall it be defiled? And the priests answered
and said: It shall be defiled
SI TETIGERIT POLLUTUS: If one that is unclean … touch
et dixit: Sic populus iste: and said: So is this people
ante faciem meam, dicit Dominus,: before my face, saith the Lord
et sic omne opus manuum eorum: and so is all the work of their hands
that they have offered there, shall be defiled
Et nunc ponite corda vestra: And now consider in your hearts
a die hac et supra antequam poneretur la: from this day and upward, before there was a stone laid upon a stone
in domo templo Domini: in the temple of the Lord
ad acervum viginti modiorum: to a heap of twenty bushels
et fierent decem et intraretis: and they became ten: and you went
Percussi vos vento urente: I struck you with a blasting wind
et grandine omnia opera manuum vestrarum: and with hail, all the works of your hand, yet there was none among you that returned to me, saith the Lord
Ponite corda vestra ex die ista: Set your hearts from this day
et in futurum a die vicesima et quarta n: and henceforward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month: from the day that the foundations … were laid
sunt templi Domini ponite super cor vest: of the temple of the Lord … and lay it up in your hearts
iam semen in germine est?: the seed as yet sprung up?
vinea et ficus et malogranatum et lignum: the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree … flourished?
from this day I will bless you
Et factum est verbum Domini secundo ad A: And the word of the Lord came a second time to Aggeus in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying
et conteram fortitudinem regni gentium: and will destroy the strength of the kingdom of the Gentiles
et subvertam quadrigam: and I will overthrow the chariot
et ascensorem eius et descendent equi et: and him that rideth therein: and the horses and their riders shall come down
every one by the sword of his brother
In die illo, dicit Dominus exercituum,: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts
assumam te Zorobabel fili Salathiel serv: I will take thee, O Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, my servant
